title: RBI Data: CASA Share Hits 2-Year Low of 37.9% & CD Ratio Reaches Record 83%
summary: RBI banking data reveals CASA share fell to 37.9% in Dec 2025 as credit growth (13.5%) continued to outpace deposit growth (10.8%).

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Data: CASA Share Hits 2-Year Low of 37.9% & CD Ratio Reaches Record 83%. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI released quarterly data showing CASA deposits dropped by 210 bps YoY to 37.9% in Dec 2025. Total bank credit reached **₹207.7 lakh crore** (+13.5% YoY) while aggregate deposits stood at **₹250.1 lakh crore** (+10.8% YoY).
**Credit-Deposit (CD) Ratio**: Reached an all-time high of **83%**.
**Impact**: CASA erosion raises banks' cost of funds, tightening margin management across commercial lenders.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
